response.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rental_rate FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating;

assumptions.assumption: “20.99 as the cutoff” means films with replacement_cost greater than or equal to 20.99.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff excludes films priced exactly at 20.99, use a strict greater-than comparison.
